stem.en: Riya starts a startup that sells snacks made from millets. After a year of honest effort, it closes down. What is the right way to see this failure?

text.en: It proves that she should never try to start any business again.
It shows that every startup closes down in its very first year.
It is nothing to be ashamed of, and its lessons help her next idea.
It means only the customers were wrong, so there is nothing to learn.

explanation.en: There is nothing wrong with failure if an honest effort has been made. Every failed attempt teaches lessons that help entrepreneurs build stronger ideas and better businesses later.

hints.en: Some startups grow fast and some close down. What can a founder take from one that closed?
